---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL CSProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL CSNat == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
LOCAL CSSeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
LOCAL CSWF == INSTANCE WellFoundedInduction

LEMMA CSEmptyCommitted == CommittedTxns(<<>>) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range

LEMMA CSNoCommittedEdges ==
  ASSUME NEW h, CommittedTxns(h) = {}
  PROVE CahillMVSG(h) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG

LEMMA CSEmptyCycles == FindAllNodesInAnyCycle({}) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle

LEMMA CSInitialSafety == Init => CahillSerializable(history)
  BY CSEmptyCommitted, CSNoCommittedEdges, CSEmptyCycles,
     CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, CahillSerializable, IsCycle

CSGraphNodes(es) == UNION {{e[1], e[2]} : e \in es}
CSNeighbors(es, n) == {e[2] : e \in {e \in es : e[1] = n}}
CSCycleStep(es, f, n) ==
  [v \in SUBSET CSGraphNodes(es) |->
    IF n \in v THEN {n}
    ELSE UNION {f[m][v \union {n}] : m \in CSNeighbors(es, n)}]
CSCycleFn(es) ==
  LET f[n \in CSGraphNodes(es)] == CSCycleStep(es, f, n)
  IN f
CSReverseRank(es, r, b) ==
  CSWF!PreImage(LAMBDA n : b - r[n], CSGraphNodes(es),
               CSWF!OpToRel(<, Nat))
CSRanked(es, r, b) ==
  /\ b \in Nat
  /\ r \in [CSGraphNodes(es) -> 0..b]
  /\ es \subseteq CSGraphNodes(es) \X CSGraphNodes(es)
  /\ \A e \in es : r[e[1]] < r[e[2]]

LEMMA CSNeighborsInNodes ==
  ASSUME NEW es, NEW n
  PROVE CSNeighbors(es, n) \subseteq CSGraphNodes(es)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSNeighbors, CSGraphNodes

LEMMA CSRankRelationWellFounded ==
  ASSUME NEW es, NEW r, NEW b, CSRanked(es,r,b)
  PROVE CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSReverseRank(es,r,b), CSGraphNodes(es))
<1>1. \A n \in CSGraphNodes(es) : b - r[n] \in Nat
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSRanked
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSWF!NatLessThanWellFounded, CSWF!PreImageWellFounded,
     CSProof!IsaM("blast")
     DEF CSReverseRank

LEMMA CSNeighborRank ==
  ASSUME NEW es, NEW r, NEW b, CSRanked(es,r,b),
         NEW n \in CSGraphNodes(es), NEW m \in CSNeighbors(es,n)
  PROVE /\ r[n] < r[m]
        /\ m \in CSWF!SetLessThan(n,CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es))
  BY CSNeighborsInNodes, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF CSRanked, CSNeighbors, CSReverseRank, CSWF!PreImage,
         CSWF!OpToRel, CSWF!SetLessThan

LEMMA CSCycleRecursion ==
  ASSUME NEW es, NEW r, NEW b, CSRanked(es,r,b)
  PROVE CSCycleFn(es) =
          [n \in CSGraphNodes(es) |-> CSCycleStep(es,CSCycleFn(es),n)]
<1>1. CSWF!WFDefOn(CSReverseRank(es,r,b), CSGraphNodes(es),
                   LAMBDA f,n : CSCycleStep(es,f,n))
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW g, NEW h, NEW n \in CSGraphNodes(es),
            \A m \in CSWF!SetLessThan(n,CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es)) :
              g[m] = h[m]
         PROVE CSCycleStep(es,g,n) = CSCycleStep(es,h,n)
    BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSWF!WFDefOn
  <2>2. \A m \in CSNeighbors(es,n) : g[m] = h[m]
    BY <2>1, CSNeighborRank, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSCycleStep
<1>2. CSWF!OpDefinesFcn(CSCycleFn(es),CSGraphNodes(es),
                       LAMBDA f,n : CSCycleStep(es,f,n))
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSWF!OpDefinesFcn, CSCycleFn
<1>3. CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es))
  BY CSRankRelationWellFounded, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. CSWF!WFInductiveDefines(CSCycleFn(es),CSGraphNodes(es),
                              LAMBDA f,n : CSCycleStep(es,f,n))
  BY ONLY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, CSWF!WFInductiveDef, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSWF!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA CSRankedGraphAcyclic ==
  ASSUME NEW es, NEW r, NEW b, CSRanked(es,r,b)
  PROVE FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(es) = {}
<1>1. DEFINE Good(n) ==
        \A v \in SUBSET CSGraphNodes(es) :
          (\A m \in v : r[m] < r[n]) => CSCycleFn(es)[n][v] = {}
<1>H. HIDE DEF Good
<1>2. \A n \in CSGraphNodes(es) :
        (\A m \in CSWF!SetLessThan(n,CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es)) :
            Good(m)) => Good(n)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in CSGraphNodes(es),
          \A m \in CSWF!SetLessThan(n,CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es)) :
            Good(m),
          NEW v \in SUBSET CSGraphNodes(es),
          \A m \in v : r[m] < r[n]
        PROVE CSCycleFn(es)[n][v] = {}
    BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good
  <2>2. n \notin v
    BY <2>1, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSRanked
  <2>3. \A m \in CSNeighbors(es,n) : CSCycleFn(es)[m][v \union {n}] = {}
    BY <2>1, CSNeighborRank, CSNeighborsInNodes, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF Good, CSRanked
  <2>4. CSCycleFn(es)[n] = CSCycleStep(es,CSCycleFn(es),n)
    BY CSCycleRecursion, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSCycleStep
<1>W. CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSReverseRank(es,r,b),CSGraphNodes(es))
  BY CSRankRelationWellFounded, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. \A n \in CSGraphNodes(es) : Good(n)
  BY ONLY <1>2, <1>W, CSWF!WFInduction, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>4. \A n \in CSGraphNodes(es) : CSCycleFn(es)[n][{}] = {}
  BY <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good
<1>5. FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(es) =
        UNION {CSCycleFn(es)[n][{}] : n \in {e[1] : e \in es}}
  BY CSProof!IsaM("simp") DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle, CSCycleFn, CSCycleStep, CSGraphNodes, CSNeighbors
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSGraphNodes

CSCommittedHistory(h) ==
  SelectSeq(h, LAMBDA e : e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(h))
CSBeginPosition(h,t) ==
  IndexOfOpInHistory(CSCommittedHistory(h), [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> t])
CSCommitPosition(h,t) ==
  IndexOfOpInHistory(CSCommittedHistory(h), [op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t])
CSWritePosition(h,t,k) ==
  IndexOfOpInHistory(CSCommittedHistory(h), [op |-> "write", txnid |-> t, key |-> k])
CSWriteWrite(h,s,t,k) ==
  /\ CSWritePosition(h,s,k) /= -1
  /\ CSWritePosition(h,t,k) /= -1
  /\ CSWritePosition(h,s,k) < CSWritePosition(h,t,k)
CSReadWrite(h,s,t,k) ==
  /\ k \in KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,s,"read")
  /\ CSWritePosition(h,t,k) /= -1
  /\ CSBeginPosition(h,s) < CSCommitPosition(h,t)
CSBefore(h,s,t) == CSCommitPosition(h,s) < CSBeginPosition(h,t)
CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc) ==
  /\ Len(CSCommittedHistory(h)) \in Nat
  /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
       /\ CSBeginPosition(h,t) \in 1..Len(CSCommittedHistory(h))
       /\ CSCommitPosition(h,t) \in 1..Len(CSCommittedHistory(h))
       /\ CSBeginPosition(h,t) < CSCommitPosition(h,t)
       /\ ~(ic[t] /\ oc[t])
  /\ \A s,t \in CommittedTxns(h) : s /= t =>
       /\ \A k \in Key : CSWriteWrite(h,s,t,k) => CSBefore(h,s,t)
       /\ \A k \in Key : CSReadWrite(h,s,t,k) =>
                            CSBefore(h,s,t) \/ (oc[s] /\ ic[t])
CSTimestamp(h,oc,t) ==
  IF oc[t] THEN CSBeginPosition(h,t) ELSE CSCommitPosition(h,t)
CSHistoryRank(h,oc) ==
  [t \in CSGraphNodes(CahillMVSG(h)) |-> CSTimestamp(h,oc,t)]

LEMMA CSMVSGNodes ==
  ASSUME NEW h
  PROVE /\ CahillMVSG(h) \subseteq CommittedTxns(h) \X CommittedTxns(h)
        /\ CSGraphNodes(CahillMVSG(h)) \subseteq CommittedTxns(h)
        /\ CahillMVSG(h) \subseteq
             CSGraphNodes(CahillMVSG(h)) \X CSGraphNodes(CahillMVSG(h))
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CahillMVSG, CSGraphNodes

LEMMA CSTimestampBounds ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW ic, NEW oc, CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc),
         NEW t \in CommittedTxns(h)
  PROVE /\ CSTimestamp(h,oc,t) \in 1..Len(CSCommittedHistory(h))
        /\ CSBeginPosition(h,t) <= CSTimestamp(h,oc,t)
        /\ CSTimestamp(h,oc,t) <= CSCommitPosition(h,t)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSCoreInvariant, CSTimestamp

LEMMA CSEdgesIncreaseTimestamp ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW ic, NEW oc, CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc),
         NEW e \in CahillMVSG(h)
  PROVE CSTimestamp(h,oc,e[1]) < CSTimestamp(h,oc,e[2])
<1>1. e[1] \in CommittedTxns(h) /\ e[2] \in CommittedTxns(h) /\ e[1] /= e[2]
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CahillMVSG
<1>2. CSBefore(h,e[1],e[2]) \/
       (oc[e[1]] /\ ic[e[2]] /\ CSBeginPosition(h,e[1]) < CSCommitPosition(h,e[2]))
  BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF CSCoreInvariant, CahillMVSG, CSWriteWrite, CSReadWrite, CSBefore,
         CSBeginPosition, CSCommitPosition, CSWritePosition, CSCommittedHistory
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSTimestampBounds, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF CSCoreInvariant, CSTimestamp, CSBefore

LEMMA CSCoreGivesRank ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW ic, NEW oc, CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc)
  PROVE CSRanked(CahillMVSG(h),CSHistoryRank(h,oc),Len(CSCommittedHistory(h)))
<1>1. CSHistoryRank(h,oc) \in
        [CSGraphNodes(CahillMVSG(h)) -> 0..Len(CSCommittedHistory(h))]
  BY CSMVSGNodes, CSTimestampBounds, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF CSHistoryRank
<1>2. \A e \in CahillMVSG(h) :
       CSHistoryRank(h,oc)[e[1]] < CSHistoryRank(h,oc)[e[2]]
  BY CSMVSGNodes, CSEdgesIncreaseTimestamp, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF CSHistoryRank
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSMVSGNodes, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSRanked, CSCoreInvariant

LEMMA CSCoreImpliesSerializable ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW ic, NEW oc, CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc)
  PROVE CahillSerializable(h)
<1>1. CSRanked(CahillMVSG(h),CSHistoryRank(h,oc),Len(CSCommittedHistory(h)))
  BY CSCoreGivesRank, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSRankedGraphAcyclic, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CahillSerializable, IsCycle

LEMMA CSEmptySelect ==
  ASSUME NEW Test(_)
  PROVE SelectSeq(<<>>,Test) = <<>>
<1>1. [i \in 0..0 |-> <<>>] =
        [i \in 0..Len(<<>>) |->
           IF i = 0 THEN <<>>
           ELSE IF Test(<<>>[i])
                THEN Append([j \in 0..0 |-> <<>>][i-1],<<>>[i])
                ELSE [j \in 0..0 |-> <<>>][i-1]]
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA CSInitialCore == Init => CSCoreInvariant(history,inConflict,outConflict)
<1>1. CSCommittedHistory(<<>>) = <<>>
  BY CSEmptySelect, CSProof!IsaM("blast") DEF CSCommittedHistory
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSEmptyCommitted, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSCoreInvariant, Init

CSStateCore == CSCoreInvariant(history,inConflict,outConflict)

LEMMA CSCoreStuttering ==
  CSStateCore /\ UNCHANGED allvars => CSStateCore'
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSStateCore, allvars

LEMMA CSSelectAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE SelectSeq(Append(h,e),Test) =
          IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(h,Test),e) ELSE SelectSeq(h,Test)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSSelectType ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE SelectSeq(h,Test) \in Seq(S)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSAppendRange ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e
  PROVE Range(Append(h,e)) = Range(h) \union {e}
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \union {e})
  BY CSSeq!SeqMonotonic, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSSeq!AppendProperties, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSSeq!Range, Range

LEMMA CSSelectRange ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE \A h \in Seq(S) : Range(SelectSeq(h,Test)) = {e \in Range(h) : Test(e)}
<1>1. DEFINE Good(h) == Range(SelectSeq(h,Test)) = {e \in Range(h) : Test(e)}
<1>H. HIDE DEF Good
<1>2. Good(<<>>)
  BY CSEmptySelect, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good, Range
<1>3. \A h \in Seq(S), e \in S : Good(h) => Good(Append(h,e))
  BY CSSelectAppend, CSSelectType, CSAppendRange, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Good
<1>4. \A h \in Seq(S) : Good(h)
  BY ONLY <1>2, <1>3, CSSeq!SequencesInductionAppend, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good

LEMMA CSCommittedAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e
  PROVE CommittedTxns(Append(h,e)) =
          IF e.op = "commit" THEN CommittedTxns(h) \union {e.txnid}
                             ELSE CommittedTxns(h)
  BY CSAppendRange, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents

LEMMA CSKeysAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e, NEW t, NEW op
  PROVE KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h,e),t,op) =
          IF e.txnid = t /\ e.op = op
          THEN KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,op) \union {e.key}
          ELSE KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,op)
  BY CSAppendRange, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn, SelectEvents

LEMMA CSUncommittedAppendView ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S,
         e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h), e.op /= "commit"
  PROVE /\ CommittedTxns(Append(h,e)) = CommittedTxns(h)
        /\ CSCommittedHistory(Append(h,e)) = CSCommittedHistory(h)
        /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
             KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h,e),t,"read") =
               KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,"read")
<1>1. CommittedTxns(Append(h,e)) = CommittedTxns(h)
  BY CSCommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSSelectAppend, CSKeysAppend, CSProof!IsaM("auto") DEF CSCommittedHistory

LEMMA CSMVSGUncommittedAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S,
         e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h), e.op /= "commit"
  PROVE CahillMVSG(Append(h,e)) = CahillMVSG(h)
<1>1. /\ CommittedTxns(Append(h,e)) = CommittedTxns(h)
       /\ CSCommittedHistory(Append(h,e)) = CSCommittedHistory(h)
       /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
             KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h,e),t,"read") =
               KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,"read")
  BY CSUncommittedAppendView, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY ONLY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG, CSCommittedHistory

\* A change to an uncommitted transaction leaves the committed graph alone.
\* Incoming conflict flags may increase; outgoing flags of committed
\* transactions must remain fixed, and the commit conflict test must hold.
LEMMA CSCoreViewChange ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW hh, NEW ic, NEW oc, NEW ii, NEW oo,
         CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc),
         CommittedTxns(hh) = CommittedTxns(h),
         CSCommittedHistory(hh) = CSCommittedHistory(h),
         \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
           KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(hh,t,"read") =
             KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,"read"),
         \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
           /\ oo[t] = oc[t]
           /\ ic[t] => ii[t]
           /\ ~(ii[t] /\ oo[t])
  PROVE CSCoreInvariant(hh,ii,oo)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF CSCoreInvariant, CSBeginPosition, CSCommitPosition,
         CSWritePosition, CSWriteWrite, CSReadWrite, CSBefore

LEMMA CSCoreUncommittedAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e,
         NEW ic, NEW oc, NEW ii, NEW oo,
         CSCoreInvariant(h,ic,oc),
         e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h), e.op /= "commit",
         \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
           /\ oo[t] = oc[t]
           /\ ic[t] => ii[t]
           /\ ~(ii[t] /\ oo[t])
  PROVE CSCoreInvariant(Append(h,e),ii,oo)
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \union {e}) /\ e \in S \union {e}
  BY CSSeq!SeqMonotonic, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. /\ CommittedTxns(Append(h,e)) = CommittedTxns(h)
       /\ CSCommittedHistory(Append(h,e)) = CSCommittedHistory(h)
       /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
             KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h,e),t,"read") =
               KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h,t,"read")
  BY <1>1, CSUncommittedAppendView, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2, CSCoreViewChange, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSActiveNotCommitted ==
  ASSUME NEW t, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation(t)
  PROVE t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation, ActiveTxns, FinalizedTxns

LEMMA CSCoreInternalAbort ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore,
         inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN], outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN],
         CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId,
         NEW t, NEW reason, t \notin CommittedTxns(history), internalAbort(t,reason)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
        /\ outConflict'[u] = outConflict[u]
        /\ inConflict[u] => inConflict'[u]
        /\ ~(inConflict'[u] /\ outConflict'[u])
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF internalAbort, CSStateCore, CSCoreInvariant
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSCoreUncommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF internalAbort, CSStateCore

LEMMA CSCoreBegin ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore, NEW t, Begin(t)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Begin, CommittedTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, SelectEvents
<1>2. \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
        /\ outConflict'[u] = outConflict[u]
        /\ inConflict[u] => inConflict'[u]
        /\ ~(inConflict'[u] /\ outConflict'[u])
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Begin, CSStateCore, CSCoreInvariant
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSCoreUncommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Begin, CSStateCore

LEMMA CSCoreVoluntaryAbort ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore,
         inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN], outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN],
         CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId, NEW t, ChooseToAbort(t)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
  BY CSActiveNotCommitted, CSCoreInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ChooseToAbort

LEMMA CSCoreRead ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore,
         inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN], outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN],
         CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId,
         \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) : holdingXLocks[u] = {},
         NEW t, NEW k, Read(t,k)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSActiveNotCommitted, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Read
<1>2. CASE internalAbort(t,"in attempted read, to preserve serializability")
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSCoreInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. CASE ~internalAbort(t,"in attempted read, to preserve serializability")
  <2>1. history' = Append(history,
          [op |-> "read", txnid |-> t, key |-> k,
           ver |-> CHOOSE v \in VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(t,k) : TRUE])
    BY <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Read
  <2>2. \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
          /\ outConflict'[u] = outConflict[u]
          /\ inConflict[u] => inConflict'[u]
          /\ ~(inConflict'[u] /\ outConflict'[u])
    BY <1>1, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Read, CSStateCore, CSCoreInvariant
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>1, CSCoreUncommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSStateCore
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSCoreAcquiringWrite ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore,
         inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN], outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN],
         CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId,
         NEW t, NEW k, t \notin CommittedTxns(history), HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock(t,k)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. CASE internalAbort(t,"in attempted write, to preserve serializability")
  BY <1>1, CSCoreInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. CASE ~internalAbort(t,"in attempted write, to preserve serializability")
  <2>1. history' = Append(history,[op |-> "write", txnid |-> t, key |-> k])
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock, snapshotIsolationWriteAction
  <2>2. \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
          /\ outConflict'[u] = outConflict[u]
          /\ inConflict[u] => inConflict'[u]
          /\ ~(inConflict'[u] /\ outConflict'[u])
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock, CSStateCore, CSCoreInvariant
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, CSCoreUncommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSStateCore
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSCoreFinishingWrite ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), CSStateCore,
         inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN], outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN],
         CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId,
         \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) : waitingForXLock[u] = NoLock,
         NEW t, FinishBlockedWrite(t)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF FinishBlockedWrite
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSCoreAcquiringWrite, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF FinishBlockedWrite

LOCAL CSFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA CSFiniteBridge == \A S : CSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY CSProof!IsaM("simp") DEF CSFinite!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA CSRangeBridge == \A f : CSSeq!Range(f) = Range(f)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSSeq!Range, Range

CSForcedAbort(t) ==
  [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> t, reason |-> "forced by First Committer Wins"]
CSOne(U) == CHOOSE t \in U : TRUE
CSAbortStep(f,U) ==
  IF U = {} THEN <<>>
  ELSE LET t == CSOne(U)
       IN <<CSForcedAbort(t)>> \o f[U \ {t}]
CSAbortFunction(T) ==
  LET f[U \in SUBSET T] == CSAbortStep(f,U)
  IN f
CSAbortList(T) == CSAbortFunction(T)[T]
CSLosers(t) == {u \in TxnId : waitingForXLock[u] \in holdingXLocks[t]}
CSWaiters == {u \in TxnId : waitingForXLock[u] /= NoLock}

LEMMA CSNoLockOutside == NoLock \notin Key
  BY CSProof!NoSetContainsEverything, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF NoLock

LEMMA CSAppendSequence ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW e
  PROVE Append(h,e) \in Seq(Range(Append(h,e)))
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \union {e})
  BY CSSeq!SeqMonotonic, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. Append(h,e) \in Seq(S \union {e})
  BY <1>1, CSSeq!AppendProperties, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2, CSSeq!SeqOfRange, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSSeq!Range, Range

LEMMA CSConcatSequences ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW T, NEW g \in Seq(T)
  PROVE /\ h \o g \in Seq(Range(h \o g))
        /\ Range(h \o g) = Range(h) \union Range(g)
        /\ CommittedTxns(h \o g) = CommittedTxns(h) \union CommittedTxns(g)
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \union T) /\ g \in Seq(S \union T)
  BY CSSeq!SeqMonotonic, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. h \o g \in Seq(S \union T)
  BY <1>1, CSSeq!ConcatProperties, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. Range(h \o g) = Range(h) \union Range(g)
  BY <1>1, CSSeq!RangeConcatenation, CSRangeBridge, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSSeq!SeqOfRange, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF CSSeq!Range, Range, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents

LEMMA CSAbortRecursion ==
  ASSUME NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T)
  PROVE CSAbortFunction(T) = [U \in SUBSET T |-> CSAbortStep(CSAbortFunction(T),U)]
<1>1. CSFinite!IsWellFoundedOn(CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T)
  BY CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_FiniteSubsetsOfFinite, CSFinite!FS_StrictSubsetOrderingWellFounded,
     CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. CSFinite!WFDefOn(CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T,CSAbortStep)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW f, NEW g, NEW U \in SUBSET T,
                  \A V \in CSFinite!SetLessThan(U,CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T) :
                    f[V] = g[V]
                PROVE CSAbortStep(f,U) = CSAbortStep(g,U)
    BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSFinite!WFDefOn
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF CSAbortStep, CSOne, CSFinite!SetLessThan, CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering
<1>3. CSFinite!OpDefinesFcn(CSAbortFunction(T),SUBSET T,CSAbortStep)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSFinite!OpDefinesFcn, CSAbortFunction
<1>4. CSFinite!WFInductiveDefines(CSAbortFunction(T),SUBSET T,CSAbortStep)
  BY ONLY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, CSFinite!WFInductiveDef, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSFinite!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA CSAbortListProperties ==
  ASSUME NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T)
  PROVE /\ CSAbortList(T) \in Seq({CSForcedAbort(t) : t \in T})
        /\ Range(CSAbortList(T)) = {CSForcedAbort(t) : t \in T}
        /\ CommittedTxns(CSAbortList(T)) = {}
<1>E. CSAbortFunction(T) = [U \in SUBSET T |-> CSAbortStep(CSAbortFunction(T),U)]
  BY CSAbortRecursion, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>1. DEFINE Good(U) ==
       /\ CSAbortFunction(T)[U] \in Seq({CSForcedAbort(t) : t \in T})
       /\ Range(CSAbortFunction(T)[U]) = {CSForcedAbort(t) : t \in U}
<1>D. DEFINE DS == SUBSET T
<1>H. HIDE DEF Good, DS
<1>2. \A U \in SUBSET T :
        (\A V \in CSFinite!SetLessThan(U,CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T) : Good(V))
          => Good(U)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW U \in SUBSET T,
          \A V \in CSFinite!SetLessThan(U,CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T) : Good(V)
        PROVE Good(U)
    BY CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. CASE U = {}
    BY <2>2, <1>E, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good, CSAbortStep, Range
  <2>3. CASE U /= {}
    <3>1. DEFINE t == CSOne(U)
    <3>2. t \in U /\ Good(U \ {t})
      BY <2>1, <2>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
         DEF t, CSOne, CSFinite!SetLessThan, CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering
    <3>A. CSAbortFunction(T)[U] = CSAbortStep(CSAbortFunction(T),U)
      BY <2>1, <1>E, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
    <3>3. CSAbortFunction(T)[U] = <<CSForcedAbort(t)>> \o CSAbortFunction(T)[U \ {t}]
      BY ONLY <3>A, <2>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSAbortStep, t
    <3>4. <<CSForcedAbort(t)>> \in Seq({CSForcedAbort(x) : x \in T})
      BY <3>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
    <3>5. CSAbortFunction(T)[U] \in Seq({CSForcedAbort(x) : x \in T})
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, CSSeq!ConcatProperties, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good
    <3>6. Range(CSAbortFunction(T)[U]) =
             Range(<<CSForcedAbort(t)>>) \union Range(CSAbortFunction(T)[U \ {t}])
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, CSConcatSequences, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good
    <3>7. Range(<<CSForcedAbort(t)>>) = {CSForcedAbort(t)}
      BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Range
    <3>8. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Good
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. CSFinite!IsWellFoundedOn(CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),SUBSET T)
  BY CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_FiniteSubsetsOfFinite, CSFinite!FS_StrictSubsetOrderingWellFounded,
     CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>A. \A U \in DS :
        (\A V \in CSFinite!SetLessThan(U,CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),DS) : Good(V))
          => Good(U)
  BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF DS
<1>B. CSFinite!IsWellFoundedOn(CSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(T),DS)
  BY <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF DS
<1>C. \A U \in DS : Good(U)
  BY ONLY <1>A, <1>B, CSFinite!WFInduction, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>4. \A U \in SUBSET T : Good(U)
  BY <1>C, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF DS
<1>5. Good(T)
  BY <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>5, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF Good, CSAbortList, CSForcedAbort, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents

LEMMA CSWaiterFiniteUpdate ==
  ASSUME IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters), NEW t,
         \A u \in TxnId \ {t} :
           waitingForXLock'[u] = waitingForXLock[u] \/ waitingForXLock'[u] = NoLock
  PROVE IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
<1>1. CSWaiters' \subseteq CSWaiters \union {t}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSWaiters
<1>2. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters \union {t})
  BY CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_AddElement, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_Subset, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

CSOperationalFacts ==
  /\ NoLock \notin Key
  /\ holdingXLocks \in [TxnId -> SUBSET Key]
  /\ waitingForXLock \in [TxnId -> Key \union {NoLock}]
  /\ holdingSIREADlocks \in [TxnId -> SUBSET Key]
  /\ IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters)
  /\ history \in Seq(Range(history))
  /\ CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
  /\ inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
       /\ holdingXLocks[u] = {}
       /\ waitingForXLock[u] = NoLock

CSNoCommitHistoryStep ==
  \/ history' = history
  \/ \E e : e.op /= "commit" /\ history' = Append(history,e)

LEMMA CSBasicHistoryStep ==
  ASSUME history \in Seq(Range(history)), CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  PROVE /\ history' \in Seq(Range(history'))
        /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSAppendSequence, CSCommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSNoCommitHistoryStep

LEMMA CSInitialOperational == Init => CSOperationalFacts
<1>1. Init => CSWaiters = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, CSWaiters
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSNoLockOutside, CSEmptyCommitted, CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_EmptySet,
     CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, CSOperationalFacts, Range

LEMMA CSLosersFinite ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId
  PROVE IsFiniteSet(CSLosers(t))
<1>1. CSLosers(t) \subseteq CSWaiters
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts, CSLosers, CSWaiters
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSFiniteBridge, CSFinite!FS_Subset, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts

LEMMA CSBasicInternalAbort ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t, NEW reason, internalAbort(t,reason)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF internalAbort, CSNoCommitHistoryStep
<1>2. history' \in Seq(Range(history')) /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
  BY <1>1, CSBasicHistoryStep, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
<1>3. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
  BY CSWaiterFiniteUpdate, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSOperationalFacts, internalAbort
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSOperationalFacts, internalAbort

LEMMA CSBasicBegin ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, Begin(t)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Begin, CSNoCommitHistoryStep
<1>2. history' \in Seq(Range(history')) /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
  BY <1>1, CSBasicHistoryStep, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
<1>3. CSWaiters' = CSWaiters
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Begin, CSWaiters
<1>4. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
  BY <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Begin, CSOperationalFacts

LEMMA CSBasicRead ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key, Read(t,k)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CASE internalAbort(t,"in attempted read, to preserve serializability")
  BY <1>1, CSBasicInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. CASE ~internalAbort(t,"in attempted read, to preserve serializability")
  <2>1. CSNoCommitHistoryStep
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Read, CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  <2>2. history' \in Seq(Range(history')) /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
    BY <2>1, CSBasicHistoryStep, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
  <2>3. CSWaiters' = CSWaiters
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Read, CSWaiters
  <2>4. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
    BY <2>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
  <2>5. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>2, <2>4, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Read, CSOperationalFacts
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSBasicAcquiringWrite ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key,
         t \notin CommittedTxns(history), HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock(t,k)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CASE internalAbort(t,"in attempted write, to preserve serializability")
  BY <1>1, CSBasicInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. CASE ~internalAbort(t,"in attempted write, to preserve serializability")
  <2>1. CSNoCommitHistoryStep
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock, snapshotIsolationWriteAction, CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  <2>2. history' \in Seq(Range(history')) /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
    BY <2>1, CSBasicHistoryStep, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
  <2>3. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
    BY <1>2, CSWaiterFiniteUpdate, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF CSOperationalFacts, HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock, snapshotIsolationWriteAction
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>2, <2>3, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF CSOperationalFacts, HelperWriteCanAcquireXLock, snapshotIsolationWriteAction
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSBasicLockConflict ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key,
         t \notin CommittedTxns(history), HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock(t,k)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CSNoCommitHistoryStep
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock, CSNoCommitHistoryStep
<1>2. history' \in Seq(Range(history')) /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history)
  BY <1>1, CSBasicHistoryStep, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
<1>A. \A u \in TxnId \ {t} :
         waitingForXLock'[u] = waitingForXLock[u] \/ waitingForXLock'[u] = NoLock
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSOperationalFacts, HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock
<1>3. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
  BY <1>A, CSWaiterFiniteUpdate, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSOperationalFacts, HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock

LEMMA CSBasicStartingWrite ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key, StartWriteMayBlock(t,k)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSActiveNotCommitted, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF StartWriteMayBlock
<1>2. CASE WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(t,k) /= {}
  <2>1. internalAbort(t,"forced by First Committer Wins")
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF StartWriteMayBlock, internalAbort, CSOperationalFacts, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, CSBasicInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. CASE WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(t,k) = {}
  BY <1>1, <1>3, CSBasicAcquiringWrite, CSBasicLockConflict, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF StartWriteMayBlock
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSBasicFinishingWrite ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, FinishBlockedWrite(t)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history) /\ waitingForXLock[t] \in Key
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts, FinishBlockedWrite
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSBasicAcquiringWrite, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF FinishBlockedWrite

LEMMA CSNormalCommitHistory ==
  ASSUME NEW t, Commit(t), ~(inConflict[t] /\ outConflict[t])
  PROVE history' = Append(history,[op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t]) \o CSAbortList(CSLosers(t))
  BY CSProof!IsaM("auto")
     DEF Commit, KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn, CSLosers,
         CSAbortList, CSAbortFunction, CSAbortStep, CSOne, CSForcedAbort

LEMMA CSBasicCommit ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId, Commit(t)
  PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. CASE inConflict[t] /\ outConflict[t]
  BY <1>1, CSBasicInternalAbort, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Commit
<1>2. CASE ~(inConflict[t] /\ outConflict[t])
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(CSLosers(t))
    BY CSLosersFinite, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. /\ CSAbortList(CSLosers(t)) \in Seq({CSForcedAbort(u) : u \in CSLosers(t)})
         /\ CommittedTxns(CSAbortList(CSLosers(t))) = {}
    BY <2>1, CSAbortListProperties, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>3. history' = Append(history,[op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t]) \o CSAbortList(CSLosers(t))
    BY <1>2, CSNormalCommitHistory, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>4. LET h == Append(history,[op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t])
        IN /\ h \in Seq(Range(h))
           /\ CommittedTxns(h) = CommittedTxns(history) \union {t}
    BY CSAppendSequence, CSCommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CSOperationalFacts
  <2>5. /\ history' \in Seq(Range(history'))
         /\ CommittedTxns(history') = CommittedTxns(history) \union {t}
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, CSConcatSequences, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
  <2>6. IsFiniteSet(CSWaiters')
    BY <1>2, CSWaiterFiniteUpdate, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSOperationalFacts, Commit
  <2>7. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>5, <2>6, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
       DEF CSOperationalFacts, Commit, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSOperationalStutter ==
  CSOperationalFacts /\ UNCHANGED allvars => CSOperationalFacts'
  BY CSProof!IsaM("auto") DEF CSOperationalFacts, CSWaiters, allvars

LEMMA CSOperationalNext == CSOperationalFacts /\ [Next]_allvars => CSOperationalFacts'
<1>1. ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, NEW t \in TxnId,
             \/ Begin(t)
             \/ Commit(t)
             \/ ChooseToAbort(t)
             \/ \E k \in Key : Read(t,k) \/ StartWriteMayBlock(t,k)
             \/ FinishBlockedWrite(t)
      PROVE CSOperationalFacts'
  BY <1>1, CSBasicBegin, CSBasicCommit, CSBasicInternalAbort, CSBasicRead,
     CSBasicStartingWrite, CSBasicFinishingWrite, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF ChooseToAbort
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, CSOperationalStutter, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Next

CSDeferredSteps ==
  /\ \A t \in TxnId : CSStateCore /\ Commit(t) => CSStateCore'
  /\ \A t \in TxnId, k \in Key :
       CSStateCore /\ StartWriteMayBlock(t,k) /\ HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock(t,k)
         => CSStateCore'

LEMMA CSCoreStartingWrite ==
  ASSUME CSOperationalFacts, CSStateCore, CSDeferredSteps,
         NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key, StartWriteMayBlock(t,k)
  PROVE CSStateCore'
<1>1. t \notin CommittedTxns(history)
  BY CSActiveNotCommitted, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF StartWriteMayBlock
<1>2. CASE WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(t,k) /= {}
  <2>1. history' = Append(history,
            [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> t, reason |-> "forced by First Committer Wins"])
    BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF StartWriteMayBlock
  <2>2. \A u \in CommittedTxns(history) :
          /\ outConflict'[u] = outConflict[u]
          /\ inConflict[u] => inConflict'[u]
          /\ ~(inConflict'[u] /\ outConflict'[u])
    BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF StartWriteMayBlock, CSOperationalFacts, CSStateCore, CSCoreInvariant
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, CSCoreUncommittedAppend, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF CSOperationalFacts, CSStateCore
<1>3. CASE WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(t,k) = {}
           /\ k \in KeysCurrentlyXLockedByAnyTxn
  BY <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r5") DEF StartWriteMayBlock, CSDeferredSteps
<1>4. CASE WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(t,k) = {}
           /\ k \notin KeysCurrentlyXLockedByAnyTxn
  BY <1>1, <1>4, CSCoreAcquiringWrite, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF StartWriteMayBlock, CSOperationalFacts
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, CSProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA CSCoreNextUnderConditions ==
  CSStateCore /\ CSOperationalFacts /\ [CSDeferredSteps]_allvars /\ [Next]_allvars
    => CSStateCore'
<1>1. ASSUME CSStateCore, CSOperationalFacts, CSDeferredSteps, Next
      PROVE CSStateCore'
  <2>1. CASE LegitimateTermination /\ UNCHANGED allvars
    BY <1>1, <2>1, CSCoreStuttering, CSProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. CASE \E t \in TxnId :
              \/ Begin(t)
              \/ Commit(t)
              \/ ChooseToAbort(t)
